scenario_text: In the decaying, forgotten crypt, Elara wept over the lost silver ring. She felt a crushing, irreversible abandonment, convinced the abyss had swallowed her treasure forever. Yet, as she knelt in the suffocating gloom, a stray beam of moonlight illuminated the ring resting on the open altar, and the reflected photons directly struck Elara's wide-open retinas. Claim: Elara knows the true location of the ring.
